papers.title: Reward changes the use and structure of predictive spatial maps
papers.translated_title: 奖励改变预测性空间地图的使用和结构
papers.author: Oza, S.
papers.summary: Reward-related changes in hippocampal place-cell activity may reflect either different use of an existing spatial map or plasticity that reshapes the map. We separated these contributions in a two-pathway model: a recurrent network learned to predict sensory input and developed a spatial representation, while a reinforcement-learning controller combined this representation with an explicit goal signal to guide behavior. Replaying identical trajectories before and after learning isolated representational plasticity. Goal-directed behavior strongly concentrated place fields near reward, whereas changes to the representation were smaller and more variable. A reward-proximity teaching signal made these changes larger and more consistent, and the change was strongly attenuated when recurrent plasticity was restricted. After reward relocation, goal-related directional tuning adapted more fully than place-field organization, while withdrawing reward and proximity teaching reversed the learned field concentration. Thus, reward affects predictive spatial maps through separable mechanisms: goal information changes how an existing map is used, whereas reward-related teaching signals reshape the map itself. Our results provide a concrete framework for future experiments to disentangle how reward information, plasticity and behavior jointly shape hippocampal activity.
papers.translated_summary: 奖励相关的变化在海马位置细胞活动中可能反映的是对既有空间地图的不同使用方式，或是重塑地图的可塑性。我们在一个双通路模型中分离了这些贡献：一个循环网络学习预测感觉输入并发展出空间表征，而一个强化学习控制器将该表征与明确的目标信号结合以指导行为。在学习前后重放相同的轨迹隔离出了表征可塑性。目标导向行为强烈地将位置野集中在奖励附近，而表征的变化较小且更为多变。奖励接近性教学信号使这些变化更大且更一致，而当循环可塑性受到限制时，这种变化被强烈减弱。在奖励重新定位后，目标相关的方向调谐比位置野组织适应得更充分，而撤除奖励和接近性教学则逆转了习得的位置野集中。因此，奖励通过可分离的机制影响预测性空间地图：目标信息改变既有地图的使用方式，而奖励相关的教学信号则重塑地图本身。我们的结果为未来实验提供了一个具体框架，以厘清奖励信息、可塑性和行为如何共同塑造海马活动。

papers.title: Beyond Neural Noise: Critical Dynamics Predict Slower Reaction Times in Adults With and Without ADHD
papers.translated_title: 超越神经噪声：临界动力学预测患有和不患有ADHD的成年人反应时间较慢
papers.author: DallaVecchia, A.
papers.summary: Historically, neural variability observed during task was interpreted as noise, assumed to obscure meaningful signal and thus something to be minimized both analytically by researchers and functionally by the brain. Changes to this signal-to-noise ratio have been proposed as a possible neural mechanism behind the increased reaction-time variability (RTV) in attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). However, not all variability is the same - in some cases, variability can have some underlying statistical structure that can be beneficial to information processing. The challenge lies in distinguishing meaningful variability from random noise. The edge-of-synchrony critical point, which describes a system poised between synchronous and asynchronous regimes, could be a good theoretical framework to study these different types of neural variability. In this study, we investigate whether changes in criticality and oscillatory dynamics preceded slower behavioral responses during a bimodal continuous performance task in ADHD. We find evidence that, prior to slower responses, neural dynamics shift toward criticality in both ADHD and control groups, suggesting that increase variability in ADHD and during attention lapses are related to structured variability and not necessarily random noise. Notably, these findings run counter predictions based on the proposed model and previous literature on neural noise in this population, challenging predictions of edge-of-synchrony criticality as a unifying account of neural variability and behavioral performance. Furthermore, this effect did not emerge at the between-subject level, underscoring the limitations of relying on between-subject correlations to infer neural mechanisms.
papers.translated_summary: 历史上，任务中观察到的神经变异性被解释为噪声，被认为会遮蔽有意义的信号，因此是研究人员在分析中以及大脑在功能上都要尽量减少的东西。信号噪声比的变化曾被提出是注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）中反应时变异性（RTV）增加背后的一种可能神经机制。然而，并非所有变异性都是一样的——在某些情况下，变异性可能具有某种潜在的统计结构，这种结构可能有益于信息处理。挑战在于区分有意义的变异性和随机噪声。同步边缘临界点描述的是一个处于同步与异步状态之间的系统，它可能是研究这些不同类型神经变异性的一个良好理论框架。在本研究中，我们考察在ADHD的双模态连续操作任务中，临界性和振荡动力学的变化是否先于较慢的行为反应。我们发现有证据表明，在较慢反应之前，ADHD组和对照组中的神经动力学都向临界性偏移，这表明ADHD中以及注意失误期间的变异性增加与结构化变异性有关，而不一定是随机噪声。值得注意的是，这些发现与基于所提出模型的预测以及先前关于该人群神经噪声的文献相悖，挑战了将同步边缘临界性作为神经变异性和行为表现统一解释的预测。此外，这种效应并未在受试者间水平上出现，凸显了依赖受试者间相关性来推断神经机制的局限性。

papers.title: Multi-region two-photon calcium imaging in freely moving animals
papers.translated_title: 自由活动动物的多区域双光子钙成像
papers.author: Kjellevold-Skallerud, E.
papers.summary: Complex behaviors emerge from the coordinated activity of neural circuits distributed across widely separated brain regions. Existing optical approaches for monitoring neural activity lack the combined capability to record from anatomically distributed regions with high spatiotemporal resolution in freely moving animals. Here we introduce MINI2P-II, a 1.1-g 2P miniscope that achieves large-scale calcium imaging with high spatial resolution, deep imaging depth and dual-color imaging capability. Together with a dual-scope imaging system and a novel implantable periscope lens assembly, MINI2P-II enables simultaneous 2P imaging in widely separated or anatomically adjacent brain regions. In mice, we demonstrate inter-hemisphere coordination in bilateral motor cortex during climbing, egocentric boundary coding in simultaneous retrosplenial and posterior parietal cortex recordings, and in zebra finches, we showed large-scale behavior-dependent activity in both juvenile and adult individuals. MINI2P-II opens the door to multi-region 2P imaging across species and developmental stages in freely moving animals.
papers.translated_summary: 复杂行为源于分布在大脑相距遥远区域的神经回路的协调活动。现有的光学神经活动监测方法缺乏在自由活动动物中以高时空分辨率记录解剖上分布区域的能力。在此，我们介绍MINI2P-II，一种重1.1克的雙光子微型显微镜，能够实现具有高空间分辨率、深成像深度和双色成像能力的大规模钙成像。结合双镜成像系统和新型可植入潜望镜镜头组件，MINI2P-II能够在相距遥远或解剖上相邻的脑区同时进行雙光子成像。在小鼠中，我们展示了攀爬过程中双侧运动皮层的半球间协调、同时记录后扣带皮层和后顶叶皮层时的自我中心边界编码，并在斑胸草雀中展示了幼年和成年个体中大规模行为依赖的活动。MINI2P-II为跨物种和发育阶段的自由活动动物多区域雙光子成像打开了大门。

papers.title: Allosteric Biosensors Unravel GTPase-Effector Feedback
papers.translated_title: 变构生物传感器揭示GTP酶-效应器反馈
papers.author: Choi, M.
papers.summary: Fluorescent biosensors that report protein conformation in vivo have been invaluable for understanding how the spatio-temporal dynamics of signaling controls cells. However, for GTPases these biosensors report the activated conformation using reagents that block the binding of downstream proteins, generating dominant negative effects and altering normal cell physiology. We present here a generalizable design to make GTPase biosensors (AlloRac1 and AlloCdc42), in which a circularly permuted fluorescent protein is inserted into a conserved loop allosterically connected to the effector binding site, generating activity-dependent fluorescence without blocking ligand interactions. The Rac1 biosensor showed that effector interactions led to increased Rac1 activation, indicating an auto-regulatory positive feedback made visible by the new biosensor design. This feedback regulated the kinetics and localization of Rac1 activity, including Rac1 activity gradients that controlled motility. Feedback was generated through Rac1 interaction with the effector Pak1, which led to further activation of Rac1 by the guanine exchange factor {beta}-Pix. The new biosensor approach enables quantitative imaging of previously obscure spatio-temporal dynamics in GTPase regulation.
papers.translated_summary: 荧光生物传感器能够在体内报告蛋白质构象，对于理解信号传导的时空动态如何控制细胞具有不可估量的价值。然而，对于GTP酶而言，这些生物传感器使用阻断下游蛋白结合的工具来报告激活构象，从而产生显性负效应并改变正常的细胞生理。我们在此提出一种可推广的设计，用于构建GTP酶生物传感器（AlloRac1和AlloCdc42），其中将环状排列的荧光蛋白插入到与效应物结合位点变构相连的保守环中，在不阻断配体相互作用的情况下产生活性依赖性荧光。Rac1生物传感器显示，效应物相互作用导致Rac1激活增加，表明一种自身调节的正反馈，这种反馈通过新的生物传感器设计得以显现。这种反馈调节了Rac1活性的动力学和定位，包括控制运动性的Rac1活性梯度。反馈通过Rac1与效应物Pak1的相互作用产生，这导致鸟嘌呤交换因子{beta}-Pix进一步激活Rac1。这种新的生物传感器方法使得对GTP酶调控中先前不明显的时空动态进行定量成像成为可能。

papers.title: Multimodal epi-mode 3D quantitative phase and fluorescence microscopy enables supervised volumetric virtual fluorescence in bulk tissue
papers.translated_title: 多模态外延模式三维定量相位与荧光显微镜实现体组织中的监督式体积虚拟荧光
papers.author: Li, Z.
papers.summary: We introduce a multimodal microscope that combines quantitative oblique back-illumination microscopy (qOBM) with wide-field epi-fluorescence deconvolution microscopy to acquire intrinsically co-registered phase and fluorescence volumes of fresh, bulk tissue. Using paired qOBM phase and DAPI fluorescence images of fresh ex vivo mouse brain tissue, we train a supervised conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) to predict DAPI-like nuclear contrast from the structural information encoded in the phase images. Results not only demonstrate high-fidelity image translation but also show improved imaging depth and more homogeneous staining. Additionally, we combine the qOBM phase contrast with captured or virtual fluorescence nuclear images to produce volumetric pseudo-H&E representations of fresh tissue, enabling a supervised approach for achieving robust virtual histological staining. This work paves the way for virtual fluorescence imaging of many more structural targets and supervised virtual histological staining of thick, unaltered, bulk tissues ex vivo and potentially in vivo. Such capabilities could have significant implications for biological research as well as for point-of-care, intraoperative, and other clinical applications.
papers.translated_summary: 我们介绍了一种多模态显微镜，它将定量斜向背照明显微镜（qOBM）与宽场落射荧光去卷积显微镜相结合，用于获取新鲜块状组织的本征共配准相位和荧光体积。利用新鲜离体小鼠脑组织的配对qOBM相位和DAPI荧光图像，我们训练了一个监督条件生成对抗网络（cGAN），从相位图像中编码的结构信息预测类DAPI核对比度。结果不仅展示了高保真图像转换，还显示出改善的成像深度和更均匀的染色。此外，我们将qOBM相位对比度与捕获的或虚拟的荧光核图像相结合，生成新鲜组织的体积伪H&E表示，从而实现一种监督方法以实现稳健的虚拟组织学染色。这项工作为许多其他结构目标的虚拟荧光成像以及离体和潜在在体的厚实、未改变块状组织的监督虚拟组织学染色铺平了道路。此类能力可能对生物学研究以及即时检验、术中和其他临床应用产生重大影响。

papers.title: Interpreting Short Tandem Repeat Variations with Genomic Foundation Models in Olive
papers.translated_title: 利用基因组基础模型解读橄榄中的短串联重复变异
papers.author: Xia, F.
papers.summary: Short tandem repeats (STRs) are highly mutable, multiallelic variants with distinctive mutation dynamics and have been associated with phenotypic variation across diverse species. However, genome-wide STR variation remains poorly characterized in olive, and the large number of naturally occurring alleles creates a challenge for variant interpretation. Genomic language models offer a potential way to assess how STR length changes alter learned sequence representations, but their responses to natural multiallelic STR series have not been systematically evaluated. Here, we identified 117,119 polymorphic STRs across 212 Iranian and Mediterranean olive accessions. STRs recovered the major SNP-defined ancestry axes while resolving additional geographically structured subcomponents. We then quantified STR-induced embedding perturbation using three plant genomic language models: AgroNT, PlantCAD2, and GPN. Across all three models, embedding distance generally increased with repeat-length difference from the reference allele, and 7,417 loci were embedding-sensitive in all three models. These signals were robust to fixed-length input construction and exceeded those of matched nonrepetitive indels at most tested loci. Integration with oil-composition associations prioritized four exploratory loci supported by all three models. Overall, we provide a genome-wide olive STR resource and show that plant genomic language models capture reproducible responses to natural STR length variation. Combining cross-model embedding evidence with phenotype association provides a potential framework for prioritizing candidate STRs for further investigation.
papers.translated_summary: 短串联重复序列（STRs）是高度可变的多等位基因变异，具有独特的突变动态，并已被发现与多种物种的表型变异相关。然而，油橄榄中全基因组范围的STR变异仍缺乏系统表征，且大量自然存在的等位基因给变异解读带来了挑战。基因组语言模型为评估STR长度变化如何改变学习到的序列表征提供了潜在途径，但其对自然多等位基因STR序列的响应尚未得到系统评估。在本研究中，我们在212份伊朗和地中海油橄榄种质中鉴定了117,119个多态性STR。STR能够重现由SNP定义的主要祖先轴，同时解析出额外的地理结构亚组分。随后，我们利用三个植物基因组语言模型——AgroNT、PlantCAD2和GPN——量化了STR诱导的嵌入扰动。在三个模型中，嵌入距离总体上随重复长度与参考等位基因差异的增加而增大，且7,417个位点在三个模型中均对嵌入敏感。这些信号在固定长度输入构建下保持稳健，并在大多数测试位点上超过了匹配的非重复插入缺失。与油脂组成关联的整合分析优先筛选出四个由三个模型共同支持的探索性位点。总体而言，我们提供了一个全基因组油橄榄STR资源，并表明植物基因组语言模型能够捕捉对自然STR长度变化的可重复响应。将跨模型嵌入证据与表型关联相结合，为优先筛选候选STR以开展进一步研究提供了一个潜在框架。

papers.title: Cardiac unloading via a transvalvular pump prevents arrhythmias following myocardial ischemia / reperfusion by preserving coronary microcirculation and cardiomyocyte nanostructure
papers.translated_title: 经瓣膜泵实现的心脏卸载通过保护冠状动脉微循环和心肌细胞纳米结构，预防心肌缺血/再灌注后的心律失常
papers.author: Ammon, M.
papers.summary: Cardiac damage in the aftermath of myocardial ischemia / reperfusion (MI/R) compromises both electrical and mechanical function, predisposing patients to arrhythmia and heart failure. Microvascular obstruction (MVO) is increasingly recognized as a sequela of MI/R and a contributor to proarrhythmic cardiac remodeling. While transvalvular unloading (TVU) using a percutaneously delivered pump is garnering appreciation as a means of limiting infarct size and preserving mechanical function following percutaneous coronary intervention, its benefits for arrhythmia prevention remain unclear. We used a porcine model to test the hypothesis that cardiac unloading prior to and through reperfusion mitigates MVO, preserves cardiomyocyte nanostructure, and alleviates arrhythmias following MI/R. Anesthetized domestic swine undergoing acute ischemia (LAD occlusion, 90 mins) and reperfusion (120 mins) were randomized to TVU (n=5) and no treatment (control; n=6) treatments. Thioflavin-S was infused into the mid-LAD to assess coronary microcirculation and quantify MVO. Arrhythmia burden was assessed by in vivo electrocardiography using 3 lead EKG. Cardiac tissues were preserved for histology and optical microscopy studies. Compared to no treatment controls, TVU hearts evidenced significantly reduced infarct area (48 +/- 5 % vs. 59 +/- 11 % p = 0.03) and MVO (19 +/- 4 % vs. 27 +/- 5% , p = 0.03) normalized to area at risk and a higher myocardial salvage index (52 +/- 5 % vs. 41 +/- 11% p = 0.03). Extensive perivascular edema, and neutrophil infiltration observed in controls was markedly reduced in TVU hearts. Confocal microscopy and spatial pattern analysis revealed significantly mitigated disruption of gap junctions and NaV1.5 dissociation from N-cadherin in TVU hearts compared to controls. Importantly, severity-adjusted arrhythmia burden during reperfusion was significantly lower in TV-P hearts (8+/-8 vs. 12+/-5 episodes lasting greater than 5seconds in controls). Our results demonstrate that TVU effectively prevents arrhythmias during reperfusion by preserving coronary microvasculature and cardiomyocyte nanostructure.
papers.translated_summary: 心肌缺血/再灌注（MI/R）后的心脏损伤会损害电功能和机械功能，使患者易发生心律失常和心力衰竭。微血管阻塞（MVO）日益被认为是MI/R的后遗症之一，也是促心律失常性心脏重构的促进因素。经皮输送泵实现的经瓣膜卸载（TVU）作为经皮冠状动脉介入治疗后限制梗死面积和保护机械功能的手段正受到越来越多的认可，但其预防心律失常的益处仍不明确。我们采用猪模型检验以下假说：再灌注前及再灌注全程的心脏卸载可减轻MVO、保护心肌细胞纳米结构并减轻MI/R后的心律失常。接受急性缺血（LAD闭塞，90分钟）和再灌注（120分钟）的麻醉家猪被随机分配至TVU组（n=5）和无治疗组（对照组；n=6）。将硫黄素-S注入LAD中段以评估冠状动脉微循环并量化MVO。通过体内三导联心电图评估心律失常负荷。保留心脏组织用于组织学和光学显微镜研究。与无治疗对照组相比，TVU心脏的梗死面积（48 +/- 5 % vs. 59 +/- 11 %，p = 0.03）和MVO（以危险区面积归一化：19 +/- 4 % vs. 27 +/- 5%，p = 0.03）显著减小，心肌挽救指数更高（52 +/- 5 % vs. 41 +/- 11%，p = 0.03）。对照组中观察到的广泛血管周围水肿和中性粒细胞浸润在TVU心脏中明显减轻。共聚焦显微镜和空间模式分析显示，与对照组相比，TVU心脏中缝隙连接破坏以及NaV1.5与N-钙黏蛋白解离均显著减轻。重要的是，TVU心脏再灌注期间经严重程度校正的心律失常负荷显著更低（持续超过5秒的发作：8+/-8次 vs. 对照组12+/-5次）。我们的结果表明，TVU通过保护冠状动脉微血管和心肌细胞纳米结构，有效预防再灌注期间的心律失常。

papers.title: Genomic signals of local adaptation in UK black alder populations (Alnus glutinosa)
papers.translated_title: 英国黑桤木（Alnus glutinosa）种群局部适应的基因组信号
papers.author: Swift, P.
papers.summary: Black alder (Alnus glutinosa) is a native tree species in the British Isles, which it colonised after the last glaciation from continental refugia. It is now a widespread pioneer species, thriving on wetlands and riverbanks. We present whole genome sequence data for 324 alder seedlings grown from seed collected from 44 populations across the UK. Among these we found two triploids and one sample with trisomy at chromosome five. Removing these, we found little population genetic structure apart from diverging northern populations with lower diversity. Using Latent-Factor Mixed Models (LFMM) analyses we identified 1,364 loci whose allele frequencies were significantly associated with environmental variables. Of these loci, 93% were associated with the number of snow days. In contrast, the greatest total genomic signal (variance in SNP effect sizes of 7.38 million SNP loci) was observed for mean temperature of the wettest quarter and annual number of frost days. Estimates of maladaptation using 1.49 million SNPs, predicted that northern populations are worst adapted to present and future worst-case climates. Our results suggest that similarity of source-site temperature variables should be prioritised when choosing seed sources for new planting, and northern populations could benefit from assisted gene flow from the south.
papers.translated_summary: 黑桤木（Alnus glutinosa）是不列颠群岛的本土树种，在最后一次冰川作用之后从大陆避难所迁入定殖。它现已成为一种广泛分布的先锋树种，在湿地和河岸生长旺盛。我们呈现了324株桤木幼苗的全基因组序列数据，这些幼苗由来自英国各地44个种群的种子培育而成。在这些样本中，我们发现了两个三倍体和一个五号染色体三体的样本。剔除这些样本后，我们发现除多样性较低的北部种群存在分化外，种群遗传结构很小。利用潜因子混合模型（LFMM）分析，我们鉴定出1,364个位点，其等位基因频率与环境变量显著相关。在这些位点中，93%与降雪天数相关。相比之下，总基因组信号最大（738万个SNP位点的SNP效应量方差）的是最湿季度的平均气温和年霜冻天数。利用149万个SNP进行的适应不良估计预测，北部种群对当前和最坏情况下的未来气候的适应最差。我们的结果表明，在为新的种植选择种子来源时，应优先考虑源地温度变量的相似性，北部种群可能受益于来自南部的辅助基因流。

papers.title: Transcranial electrical stimulation for memory enhancement: A systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: 经颅电刺激增强记忆：系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Goto, Y.
papers.summary: Non-invasive brain stimulation techniques have received increasing interest for their potential to enhance memory function, a fundamental cognitive aspect of daily life. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to investigate the efficacy of transcranial electrical stimulation (tES) in enhancing memory function in healthy adults, following the pre-registered strategy at PROSPERO (CRD42022353630). A total of 113 articles (193 trials, 7,299 participants) examining tES were identified. Meta- analysis revealed a significant overall effect of tES on memory function compared with sham stimulation (standardised mean difference [95% confidence interval] = 0.19 [0.12, 0.25]). A positive pooled effect was also observed in the subgroup receiving frontal transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS). Stimulation was associated with positive pooled effects for working- and declarative-memory task performance. Significant pooled effects were observed within 1 day after stimulation; longer-term estimates were imprecise. Regarding adverse events, tingling and itching sensations on the scalp occurred more frequently in the active group than in the sham group, but no serious adverse events were reported. Limitations, including small- study effects, heterogeneity, and uneven coverage of memory domains, were noted, emphasising the need for improved experimental rigour and diversification of memory tasks. These findings suggest that tES is associated with small improvements in memory-task performance and was generally well tolerated under the studied protocols. Heterogeneity, small- study effects, and limited adverse-event reporting constrain conclusions about efficacy, durability, and safety
papers.translated_summary: 非侵入性脑刺激技术因其增强记忆功能的潜力而受到越来越多的关注，记忆功能是日常生活的基本认知方面。本系统综述与荟萃分析旨在研究经颅电刺激（tES）在增强健康成年人记忆功能方面的有效性，遵循PROSPERO预注册策略（CRD42022353630）。共纳入113篇文献（193项试验，7299名受试者）考察tES。荟萃分析显示，与伪刺激相比，tES对记忆功能具有显著的总体效应（标准化均数差[95%置信区间]=0.19[0.12，0.25]）。在接受额叶经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）的亚组中也观察到正向合并效应。刺激与工作记忆和陈述性记忆任务表现的正向合并效应相关。刺激后1天内观察到显著的合并效应；较长期的估计不精确。关于不良事件，活动组头皮刺痛和瘙痒感的发生频率高于伪刺激组，但未报告严重不良事件。研究指出了局限性，包括小样本效应、异质性和记忆领域覆盖不均衡，强调需要改进实验严谨性和记忆任务的多样化。这些发现表明，tES与记忆任务表现的轻微改善相关，且在所研究的方案下总体耐受性良好。异质性、小样本效应和有限的不良事件报告限制了对有效性、持久性和安全性的结论。

papers.title: Ibuprofen impairs fracture healing by disrupting neutrophil-mediated tissue repair
papers.translated_title: 布洛芬通过破坏中性粒细胞介导的组织修复来损害骨折愈合
papers.author: Zappia, J.
papers.summary: Neutrophils are among the first immune cells recruited to fractures, yet their contribution to bone repair remains poorly understood. Anti-inflammatory use has been linked to increased risk of non-union fractures, while prolonged neutrophil activity or failed clearance of neutrophil-derived DNA in the form of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), can also impair fracture healing. Using dynamic live imaging and cellular perturbation in adult zebrafish, we show that neutrophils play a key role in shaping the early fracture microenvironment. Neutrophils rapidly accumulated at fractures where they released NETs and exhibited the activation of gene programmes associated with matrix remodelling. Compromising neutrophil recruitment, via ibuprofen treatment or orthogonal genetic and pharmacological perturbations, dramatically increased incidence of fracture non-union and lead to altered callus architecture through delay of osteoblast differentiation and impaired mineralisation. Mechanistically, neutrophils actively interacted with key structural proteins, including laminin, fibronectin, and collagen I, through uptake, recycling and active de novo secretion pathways. Together, our findings reveal that neutrophils establish a provisional emergency fracture matrix that templates subsequent bone repair, providing a mechanistic link between early non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) exposure and impaired skeletal healing.
papers.translated_summary: 中性粒细胞是骨折后最早被招募的免疫细胞之一，但其对骨修复的贡献仍知之甚少。抗炎药物的使用与骨折不愈合风险增加有关，而中性粒细胞活性持续过久或中性粒细胞来源DNA以中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网（NETs）形式清除失败，也会损害骨折愈合。利用成年斑马鱼的动态活体成像和细胞扰动技术，我们证明中性粒细胞在塑造早期骨折微环境中发挥关键作用。中性粒细胞迅速在骨折处聚集，释放NETs，并表现出与基质重塑相关的基因程序激活。通过布洛芬处理或正交的遗传学和药理学扰动削弱中性粒细胞招募，会显著增加骨折不愈合的发生率，并通过延迟成骨细胞分化和损害矿化导致骨痂结构改变。在机制上，中性粒细胞通过摄取、回收和主动从头分泌途径，与关键结构蛋白（包括层粘连蛋白、纤连蛋白和I型胶原）积极相互作用。总之，我们的发现揭示中性粒细胞建立了一个临时应急骨折基质，为后续骨修复提供模板，从而在早期非甾体抗炎药（NSAID）暴露与骨骼愈合受损之间提供了机制联系。
